en: Black-and-white vintage photograph of a large Gothic cathedral dominating a town square. The façade shows two tall, ornate spires with intricate tracery and pinnacles, and a central lower structure with a steep roof, rose window, and pointed-arch entrance. Trees and a few people and cars appear in the foreground, suggesting a mid‑20th‑century streetscape. The overall style is late Gothic with dark stone and narrow lancet windows.
